gaps.lead: It was unfair of the referee to send him off.
gaps.explanation: should(n't) have + participle criticises a past decision.

gaps.lead: I'd love to be lying on a beach right now.
gaps.sentence: I ___ lying on a beach right now.
gaps.explanation: wish + past subjunctive: I wish I were (formal 'were', not 'was').

gaps.lead: She found it hard to understand the accent.
gaps.explanation: 'Have difficulty (in) doing' = find it hard to do.

gaps.lead: 'I have never lied to the press,' the minister said.
gaps.explanation: deny + -ing (ever strengthens the denial): denied ever lying.

gaps.lead: I can't wait to see you again.
The company is unable to guarantee an allocated car-parking space to all employees.
gaps.sentence: The company's employees shouldn't ___ allocated a car-parking space.
gaps.explanation: 'Count on being allocated' means rely on receiving.
